en.text:
Scoring hits with Tracking Missiles grant one stack of 'Grenades Prepped'. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Hold [Reload] to switch the gun to Grenade Launcher mode, loading a grenade for each stack gained. 

Grenades deal <pve 1,308 /> <pvp [134] /> damage on impact in a 5 meter radius with up to 30% fall off at the edges. Grenades deal no self-damage.
